column1: # Pinned descriptor set for the E4 channel (decision D8).
# Lines beginning with '#' are commentary; rejected descriptors are listed at the
# bottom with their rejection reason so nobody re-adds one without seeing the cost.
# FROZEN. This list is definitional for the foundation model and does not change.
# It is not re-derived per corpus and not re-tuned at M0. Changing it invalidates
# every checkpoint, every cached vector, and every benchmark number at once — that
# is a new model version, not an edit. The generator exists to document how this
# list was derived, not as a step in any workflow.
# corpus: RDKit NCI first_5K, element-filtered. FROZEN 2026-07-21 — definitional, not to be regenerated.
#   costs are EFFECTIVE: shared-subcomputation groups are charged once, not per member
# NOTE: costs are wall-clock and therefore hardware-dependent. That is precisely why
# this list is pinned rather than recomputed at import — a runtime threshold would
# silently produce different feature layouts on different machines.
# RULE: include a descriptor if it is cheap OR if the cheap set cannot linearly
# reconstruct it (R2 < 0.95). Cost and information are nearly uncorrelated, so cost
# alone drops real axes. No variance or correlation filtering against any specific
# corpus: a frozen input space must not depend on which dataset was handy.
